composition_subtypes.role: order points by y then x for sweep-line processing

payload.core_composition_summary: Sweep line with sorting, two-pointer iteration over x per y, and segment tree for range sums to count distinct subsets.
payload.rationale: Sorting by y and x enables ordered processing, two-pointer over x groups ensures each point processed once, segment tree maintains active x counts for O(log n) range queries.
